title: Henon-map basin-valid initial-condition rejection rule
trigger: A pre-outcome numerical-feasibility audit found that the frozen Henon-map initial-condition rule can draw states outside the basin of a finite 180-sample trajectory after the frozen 1000-step burn-in. Development seeds 1001-1010 all passed; final seed 2003 failed before any model fitting or performance metric was computed.

rejection_rule.draw_order: Draw candidate pairs sequentially from one numpy.random.default_rng(dgp_seed): x_candidate first, then y_candidate.
rejection_rule.derivation: 1000 burn-in updates + 179 updates between the 180 returned samples
rejection_rule.candidate_is_accepted_if: For the complete 1179-update feasibility horizon, both state components remain finite and abs(x)<=1e6 and abs(y)<=1e6 at every checked state.
rejection_rule.candidate_is_rejected_if: Either component is non-finite or exceeds the escape guard in absolute value.
rejection_rule.on_rejection: Draw the next x,y pair from the same RNG and test again.
rejection_rule.exhaustion_behavior: Fatal RuntimeError; no fallback trajectory and no seed substitution.
rejection_rule.generation_after_acceptance: Restart the Henon recurrence from the accepted candidate and generate the frozen 1000-step burn-in followed by 180 x observations exactly as before.

development_seeds_1001_1010.effect_of_A008: none; first candidate remains accepted for all 10 seeds

performance_blindness: The amendment was triggered and specified using DGP numerical feasibility only. No PC-NFPSO or baseline model was fitted for the audit, no forecast metric was computed, and no development/final performance outcome was inspected.
workspace_consequence: The existing development workspace freeze bound to the pre-A008 protocol fingerprint must be retained as historical provenance but must not be used for execution. After A008 and its implementation are committed and tested, a new development workspace must be created with a new protocol fingerprint and manifest binding.
